title: fix(rest, core)!: refuse a multi-value or structured field as an import match key (#27465)
body:
domain:server#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgXcN9HaZYSEUdJWEjw

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu7dXrqazMkNZSnk4Zd21pny)_

Fixes #27465

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — an update / upsert import whose `matchFields`, or whose named mapping's `upsertKey`, names a field stored as a JSON column was accepted and then failed every row; the door now refuses it with `400 INVALID_REQUEST` before any row. One surface is widened: `@objectstack/core` gains one root export, `multiValueMatchKeyRefusal(matchFields, metaMap, keyedBy?)` (beside `runImport`, through `export * from './utils/import-runner.js'`), so the door and the runner judge one rule.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here — content/docs/data-modeling/import-mappings.mdx (the 400 INVALID_REQUEST reasons list names the multi-value / structured match-key refusal; the per-row results table adds the runner-path VALIDATION_ERROR row), prose-only commit 1e4dd12c

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：导入（更新 / 更新或新建）时，匹配键若选了多值查找、多选、标签、JSON 这类「一格多值或结构化」的字段，导入入口直接以 400 拒绝并点名该字段，不再让每一行都报一条看不懂的 SQL 绑定错误。
- **为什么改**：企业客户在导入向导里勾选多值查找作匹配键，28 行全部失败；这类字段本来就无法唯一定位一条记录。分诊要求「选一条规则并写明，绝不把裸 SQL 错给用户」，席位选了规则一：不能作匹配键。
- **风险与回滚**：只收窄一种此前必然全行失败的请求，原本能成功的导入行为不变；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/core/src/utils/import-runner.ts`（`multiValueMatchKeyRefusal` 判据与 runner 守卫）、`packages/rest/src/import-prepare.ts`（入口拒绝，命名映射的 upsertKey 同判）、`packages/rest/src/import-multi-value-match-key.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/import-multi-value-match-key.test.ts`，预期 9 个用例全过；其中卡面场景断言 400 `INVALID_REQUEST`、消息含 `"work_object"`、零读零写。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（向导不再提供多值字段的 ui 半另立 `domain:ui` 卡）。

## What changes

- **The rule, one definition** (`multiValueMatchKeyRefusal`, `@objectstack/core`, exported beside `runImport`). A match key cannot name a field stored as a JSON column, asked of the spec, never re-spelled: `isMultiValueField` (a multi-capable type flagged `multiple: true`: `lookup`, `user`, `select`, `radio`, `file`, `image`; or an inherently multi option type: `multiselect`, `checkboxes`, `tags`) or `STRUCTURED_JSON_TYPES` (`json`, `composite`, `repeater`, `record`, `location`, `address`, `vector`). A single-value lookup or file field and every scalar field stay legal keys. A name the field map does not carry is judged by nobody, as cell coercion passes it through. The message names each offending field with its kind, for example `"work_object" (lookup, multiple: true)`, and says to match on single-value fields.
- **The door** (`prepareImportRequest`, `@objectstack/rest`, so the sync import and the async import-job route alike). Once the object's field map is resolved, an update / upsert request whose key names such a field is refused with `400 INVALID_REQUEST`, before any row is read, matched or written, on the dry run and the commit. A named mapping's `upsertKey`, when it supplies the key, is judged the same way and the message names the mapping. Insert mode matches nothing, so a `matchFields` it carries is not judged.
- **The runner** (`runImport`). The programmatic path gets a guard: the connector pull (`@objectstack/service-automation`) writes a mapping's `upsertKey` straight into `runImport` without the door, so the runner fails every row with `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `field` = the first offending field and the same message, before any row is coerced, read or written (the lookup cells' own reference resolution included), and reports progress once. `VALIDATION_ERROR` is a standard-catalog code; `INVALID_REQUEST` is not registered under `@objectstack/core` in the error-code ledger, so the runner does not stamp it.

## Why

Measured at base (`d4ff1a02`, through the real `POST /data/:object/import` over better-sqlite3), an upsert keyed on each kind answered `200` with every row failed, dry run and commit alike:

- `multiple: true` lookup, `multiselect`, `tags`: `INVALID_FILTER` — `The implicit-equality comparand on field "work_object" requires a single comparable value, but received an array (["prj_a","prj_b"]) …`
- `json`: `FILTER_TOKEN_UNKNOWN` — `Unresolvable filter placeholder "{"a":1}" …`, a wrong answer about a filter token the author never wrote.

So the JSON-stored kinds beside the card's lookup are in the rule on measurement, not by analogy. Exact array or object equality is order- and serialization-sensitive even where a backend could evaluate it, so refusing is the rule triage asked to pick (comment 6491237090), not matching on the set.

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/import-multi-value-match-key.test.ts` (new, 9 cases, real route over a real `SqlDriver`): the card's lookup in upsert and update, commit and dry run; beside a scalar in one key set and as a later ordered key set; multiselect, tags and json, one by one and all named in one answer; a named mapping's `upsertKey`; each refusal pin asserts `400`, `INVALID_REQUEST`, the field named, no `results`, and that `findData` / `updateData` / `createManyData` were never called and the stored rows are unchanged. Preservation pins: a scalar key upserts with the lookup written as an ordinary column (the arguments that landed), and an insert carrying such a key is not judged.
- `packages/core/src/utils/import-runner-multi-value-match-key.test.ts` (new, 23 cases): the rule on all eleven refused kinds and on its boundary (scalar fields, a single-value lookup, a single-value file field, an unknown name, ordered sets of legal keys); `runImport` in upsert commit, upsert dry run and update commit fails every row with the refusal and calls nothing on the protocol; a later ordered key set is refused the same way; insert and a scalar key are preserved.

## Acceptance notes

- **Open-PR overlap.** None of the 29 open pull requests' heads differs from `main` on `import-prepare.ts` or `import-runner.ts` (read at this PR's creation), so no merge-tree conflict is possible on this diff's source files.
- **The wizard half is not in this diff.** `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.tsx` still offers every mapped field under "Match on" (its field shape carries no `multiple`). It is a separate `domain:ui` card that links back to #27465; until it lands, ticking such a field now meets this door's 400 instead of 28 row errors.
- **Spec describe.** `ImportRequestSchema.matchFields`'s describe (`packages/spec/src/api/export.zod.ts`) does not yet say a multi-value or structured field is refused. `packages/spec/**` is outside this card's file surface; noted for the seat.
- **Branch name.** The card thread can push only its harness-assigned branch `claude/project-thread-138abn`, not `claude/issue-27465-…` (the claim records the exception).
- **Clause-② (narrowing)** owes one contract-tier review before the queue, run by the seat.
